activities.description: Hi, wanted to add on some detail on my passion project. I started the adaptation of an initiative I thought was meaningful (existing in North America and some countries in Europe) but unknown to my home country by collaborating with some local libraries and science museums at first, starting with funds I obtained in a grant from my school (initiation stage). During my gap year, I was able to expand the number of sites to several times of the original location (working with other regions in my country) thanks to additional funds and increased the reach greatly. I also authored a research paper to share its progress in the past year (which I called the continuation stage the of the project). I divided these 2 stages of the same project on the common app activities because the time commitment differed greatly when I was abroad vs. when I was back home.
